3.description: Identify POST /api/search mode rag as direct evidence retrieval for caller-owned generation; knowledge:search required.
Use nonempty content of text_span hits as evidence.
Preserve parent source kind/id/title and available chunk IDs/indexes; do not confuse passage ID with parent document ID.
GET supports browse only; total counts returned hits, not all matching library sources.
Assign supplied evidence labels and constrain generated references; insufficient evidence when results are empty.
Optional full document text requires knowledge:read and view=full, using line-window continuation fields.
Filters cannot broaden credential grants; optional qualification/relevance is not factual truth verification.

4.description: Multipart POST /api/documents/upload with file and visibility; personal/CLI write credential required, restricted keys cannot upload.
201 means stored/queued for processable documents, not processing success; save document.id.
Poll processing.checkStatusAt with same authorized credential; checkInterval suggests five seconds.
Track pending -> processing -> completed/failed and do not equate HTTP upload/poll success with processing success.
DOCUMENT_PROCESSING_MODE inline default vs worker; atomic conditional pending->processing claim prevents simultaneous claims.
Processing extracts text and delegates outline/classification/summary/chunk/embedding indexing; some uploads omit processing.
503 queue saturation with Retry-After; auth rate limits can yield 429.
Processing claim does not make upload idempotent; check whether created after lost response before blindly retrying.
